instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. blocker (line 3860): initializeScene (line 3860), resetScene (line 3720), and loadFileToCanvas (line 11169) call this.scene.setActivePageId(...) without { triggerUpdate: false } immediately before syncActionResult / replaceAllElements (which already calls triggerUpdate()), causing redundant sceneNonce PRNG consumption and renders; additionally, syncActionResult (line 3292) computes const allPages = !!nextPageId && nextPageId !== this.state.activePageId, which is false when restoring a multi-page scene whose activePageId equals the initial this.state.activePageId ('page-1'), dropping elements on non-active pages. — fix: Pass { triggerUpdate: false } to this.scene.setActivePageId(...) in resetScene (line 3720), initializeScene (line 3860), and loadFileToCanvas (line 11169), and update syncActionResult (line 3292) so allPages is true whenever nextPageId is present or res.elements contains elements with a pageId different from this.scene.getActivePageId().
2. blocker (line 2804): Per-page undo history (AC-4) fails because: (1) activatePage (lines 2804-2828) switches this.scene.setActivePageId(pageId) before committing pending store actions for the outgoing page and then calls scheduleMicroAction(NEVER), which causes StoreSnapshot to treat previous-page elements still in this.store.snapshot.elements as deleted (isDeleted: true, version + 1); and (2) updateScene (lines 5177-5204) calls this.store.scheduleMicroAction before updating activePageId and without normalizing elements with withElementPageId, leaving pageId undefined in StoreSnapshot while Scene.replaceAllElements stamps pageId on scene elements. — fix: In activatePage, first commit pending changes on the outgoing page via this.store.commit(this.scene.getElementsMapIncludingDeleted(), this.state), then call this.scene.setActivePageId(pageId) and this.history.setActivePageId(pageId), and reset this.store.snapshot = StoreSnapshot.create(this.scene.getElementsMapIncludingDeleted(), getObservedAppState({ ...this.state, ...nextState })) instead of calling scheduleMicroAction; in updateScene (lines 5177-5204), apply any appState.activePageId switch first and normalize elements with withElementPageId(el, el.pageId ?? this.scene.getActivePageId()) before passing them to scheduleMicroAction and replaceAllElements.
